text:
Should you move from Shinjuku to Nippori for your last night before a Narita flight? We timed it: you gain 32 minutes of sleep, and spend about the same the evening before 👇

🎯 Bet you can't guess the cheapest option. See if you're right 👉 https://japanbystation.com/last-night-shinjuku-or-nippori

Our sample: be at Narita Terminal 1 by 08:30 on Thu 17 Dec 2026.

🏙️ 1️⃣ STAY IN SHINJUKU

🚃 Yamanote Line at 07:13, change at Nippori, Skyliner 15 at 07:45, Terminal 1 at 08:27. ¥2,840.

🧳 No change with your bags? The 06:34 Narita Express arrives at 07:58 for ¥3,330.

🚉 2️⃣ MOVE TO NIPPORI

⏰ You board the same Skyliner at 07:45. That is 32 minutes more in bed and no change. ¥2,580.

🔁 But the evening before you check out, ride 21 minutes across town and check in again.

💴 It can save money: APA Hotel TKP Nippori Ekimae, 200 m from the station, was ¥14,742 for 2 adults; the middle of the first 20 Shinjuku results that night was about ¥18,800.

✈️ 3️⃣ SLEEP AT THE AIRPORT

🌅 The first Skyliner reached Terminal 1 at 06:03. Need to be there earlier? 9h nine hours Narita Airport is inside Terminal 2, from ¥7,000 per person in a capsule.

✅ OUR TAKE

For an 08:00–08:30 arrival we'd stay in Shinjuku and enjoy the last evening there. Move only for big bags, a cheaper room, or a last night already on that side of town.
